essence: On the second day in the main context, the prescribed ritual action should be carried out with the specified leaf element.
The mantra drawn from the vessel placed before the image should be established in the heart.
Bathing, festival rites, and abundant food offerings may be performed or omitted according to option.
Whoever performs the consecration in this manner does so for the deity in weapon form.
The performer of this consecration attains happiness and liberation here and in the other world.
